    SELECT 1

WITH triple_elements AS (

)

FROM atom AS a
JOIN triple_elements AS t ON t.element = a.element
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, a.element ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode)
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.cdscode
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.mailcity = 'San Francisco'
  AND t.rtype = 'S'
  AND t.avgscrread + t.avgscrmath + t.avgscrwrite >= 1500
  AND f."District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')

SELECT s.school AS school_name, s.county, s.district, s.city,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
       f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS percent_eligible_frpm_k12,
       t.numtsttakr AS sat_test_takers,
       t.avgscrread AS avg_reading_score,
       t.avgscrmath AS avg_math_score,
       t.avgscrwrite AS avg_writing_score,
       t.numge1500 AS num_test_takers_ge_1500
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE LTRIM(s.cdscode, '0') = '1612590137943'

SELECT
  s.school AS school_name,
  s.phone,
  s.website,
  t.avgscrread,
  t.avgscrmath,
  t.avgscrwrite,
  s.charter,
  f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12_2014_15,
  ROUND(CAST(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS pct_frpm_eligible,
  m.max_math AS highest_active_avg_math,
  m.max_math - t.avgscrmath AS gap_below_highest_math
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT MAX(t2.avgscrmath) AS max_math
  FROM satscores AS t2
  INNER JOIN schools AS s2 ON s2.cdscode = t2.cds
  WHERE s2.statustype = 'Active' AND t2.numtsttakr >= 10
) AS m
WHERE s.cdscode = '7618040113118'

WITH target AS (
  SELECT county
  FROM schools
  WHERE LTRIM(cdscode, '0') = '1100170109835'
),
counties AS (
  SELECT 'Santa Barbara'::text AS county
  UNION
  SELECT county FROM target
)
SELECT c.county AS county_name,
       COUNT(s.cdscode) AS exclusive_virtual_schools
FROM counties c
LEFT JOIN schools s
  ON s.county = c.county
 AND s.virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY c.county
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, c.county ASC

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM public.cards
WHERE bordercolor = 'white'
  AND CASE WHEN power ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN power::numeric END < 3

WITH p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.name, s.releasedate, c.frameversion::int AS fv
  FROM public.cards c
  JOIN public.sets s ON s.code = c.setcode
  WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
    AND c.frameversion ~ '^[0-9]+$'
),
newest_frame AS (
  SELECT * FROM p WHERE fv = (SELECT max(fv) FROM p)
)
SELECT DISTINCT name, releasedate
FROM newest_frame
WHERE releasedate = (SELECT max(releasedate) FROM newest_frame)

WITH jp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fd.name AS japanese_name, c.type AS card_type, c.uuid
  FROM public.cards c
  JOIN public.foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
    AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
rc AS (
  SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM public.rulings
  GROUP BY uuid
)
SELECT jp.japanese_name,
       jp.card_type,
       COALESCE(SUM(rc.cnt), 0)::bigint AS total_rulings
FROM jp
LEFT JOIN rc ON rc.uuid = jp.uuid
GROUP BY jp.japanese_name, jp.card_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
FROM public.cards c
JOIN public.sets s ON s.code = c.setcode
JOIN public.foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND f.text IS NOT NULL
  AND f.text <> ''

SELECT s.id,
       s.name,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.language)
        FROM public.set_translations t
        WHERE t.setcode = s.code
          AND t.language IS NOT NULL) AS language_count
FROM public.sets s
WHERE s.type = 'commander'
  AND s.releasedate >= DATE '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releasedate <= DATE '2020-12-31'
  AND s.totalsetsize = (
    SELECT MAX(s2.totalsetsize)
    FROM public.sets s2
    WHERE s2.type = 'commander'
      AND s2.releasedate >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND s2.releasedate <= DATE '2020-12-31'
  )
ORDER BY s.id ASC

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2010) / COUNT(*)
  - 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2011) / COUNT(*) AS difference_percentage_points
FROM public.badges
WHERE name = 'Student'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.score > 50) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM public.posts p
WHERE p.owneruserid = (
  SELECT id FROM public.users
  WHERE reputation IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY reputation DESC, id
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.reputation)::numeric, 0) AS avg_reputation
FROM public.users u
WHERE u.id IN (
  SELECT p.owneruserid
  FROM public.posts p
  WHERE p.tags LIKE '%<r>%'
    AND p.score < 20
    AND p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT SUM(p.score) AS total_score
FROM public.postlinks pl
JOIN public.posts t ON t.id = pl.relatedpostid
JOIN public.posts p ON p.id = pl.postid
WHERE t.title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  AND p.tags LIKE '%<r>%'

WITH target AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.posts
  WHERE title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT ph.userid, u.displayname, COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
  FROM public.posthistory ph
  JOIN target t ON t.id = ph.postid
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = ph.userid
  WHERE ph.comment IS NOT NULL AND ph.comment <> ''
  GROUP BY ph.userid, u.displayname
)
SELECT displayname, edit_comment_count
FROM counts
WHERE edit_comment_count = (SELECT MAX(edit_comment_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY displayname

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(y.date, 4) = '2012' THEN y.consumption::numeric END) AS s2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(y.date, 4) = '2013' THEN y.consumption::numeric END) AS s2013
  FROM public.yearmonth y
  JOIN public.customers c ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT segment,
         (s2013 - s2012) / NULLIF(s2012, 0) * 100 AS raw_pct
  FROM seg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT segment,
         raw_pct,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY raw_pct DESC) AS rank_high,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY raw_pct ASC) AS rank_low
  FROM pct
  WHERE raw_pct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT segment,
       ROUND(raw_pct, 2) AS increase_percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_high = 1 OR rank_low = 1
ORDER BY raw_pct DESC;

SELECT c.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT y.customerid) AS customers_with_fuel_2013
FROM public.customers c
LEFT JOIN public.yearmonth y
  ON y.customerid = c.customerid
  AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
  AND y.consumption > 0
GROUP BY c.segment

SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumption)::numeric, 2) AS avg_monthly_consumption
FROM public.yearmonth
WHERE customerid = 15621
  AND date LIKE '2013%'
  AND consumption > 0

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM team_attributes AS ta
JOIN team AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.date >= '2012-01-01' AND ta.date < '2013-01-01'
  AND ta.buildupplaypassing > (
    SELECT AVG(buildupplaypassing)
    FROM team_attributes
    WHERE date >= '2012-01-01' AND date < '2013-01-01'
  )

SELECT m.season,
       COUNT(*) AS player_count,
       ROUND(AVG(p.height)::numeric, 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT mm.season, u.player_api_id
  FROM match mm
  JOIN league l ON l.id = mm.league_id
  JOIN country c ON c.id = l.country_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES (mm.home_player_1), (mm.home_player_2), (mm.home_player_3), (mm.home_player_4),
           (mm.home_player_5), (mm.home_player_6), (mm.home_player_7), (mm.home_player_8),
           (mm.home_player_9), (mm.home_player_10), (mm.home_player_11),
           (mm.away_player_1), (mm.away_player_2), (mm.away_player_3), (mm.away_player_4),
           (mm.away_player_5), (mm.away_player_6), (mm.away_player_7), (mm.away_player_8),
           (mm.away_player_9), (mm.away_player_10), (mm.away_player_11)
  ) AS u(player_api_id)
  WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    AND mm.season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
    AND u.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
) m
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = m.player_api_id
GROUP BY m.season
ORDER BY m.season

WITH mp AS (
  SELECT m.country_id, v.pid
  FROM match AS m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (m.home_player_1),(m.home_player_2),(m.home_player_3),(m.home_player_4),(m.home_player_5),(m.home_player_6),
    (m.home_player_7),(m.home_player_8),(m.home_player_9),(m.home_player_10),(m.home_player_11),
    (m.away_player_1),(m.away_player_2),(m.away_player_3),(m.away_player_4),(m.away_player_5),(m.away_player_6),
    (m.away_player_7),(m.away_player_8),(m.away_player_9),(m.away_player_10),(m.away_player_11)
  ) AS v(pid)
  WHERE v.pid IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS cnt
  FROM country AS c
  JOIN mp ON mp.country_id = c.id
  LEFT JOIN player AS p ON p.player_api_id = mp.pid AND p.weight <= 160
  GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT name
FROM counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM counts)

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate
  FROM player_attributes
  ORDER BY player_api_id, date DESC, id DESC
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attacking_work_rate = 'low') / COUNT(*), 1) AS low_attacking_work_rate_pct
FROM latest
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS matches_played
FROM player AS p
LEFT JOIN match AS m
  ON m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND p.player_api_id = ANY (ARRAY[
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6,
    m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6,
    m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  ])
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND p.birthday >= '1991-01-01'
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN("date"))::date AS m
  FROM public.account
),
d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dist.district_id, dist.a2 AS district_name, CAST(dist.a4 AS bigint) AS population
  FROM public.account a
  JOIN public.district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
  CROSS JOIN first_month f
  WHERE a."date" >= f.m
    AND a."date" < (f.m + INTERVAL '1 month')::date
)
SELECT district_id, district_name, population
FROM d
WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM d)
ORDER BY district_id

SELECT ROUND(AVG(di.a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_of_average_salaries,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM public.district di
WHERE LOWER(di.a3) = 'east bohemia'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.account a
    JOIN public.disp ds ON ds.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN public.client c ON c.client_id = ds.client_id
    WHERE a.district_id = di.district_id
      AND c.birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01'
      AND c.birth_date <= DATE '1989-12-31'
  )

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount)::numeric, 0), 2) AS sipo_percentage
FROM trans AS t
INNER JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a2 = 'Pisek'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''

WITH top3 AS (
  SELECT
    district_id,
    a2,
    CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) AS inhabitants,
    a16 AS crimes_1996
  FROM public.district
  WHERE LOWER(a3) = 'central bohemia'
  ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC,
           TRANSLATE(LOWER(a2), 'áäčďéěëíňóöřšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeeinoorstuuuyz') ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(a16) AS avg_all
  FROM public.district
)
SELECT
  t.a2 AS district_name,
  t.crimes_1996,
  ROUND(AVG(t.crimes_1996) OVER ()::numeric, 2) AS avg_top3_crimes_1996,
  ROUND(o.avg_all::numeric, 2) AS avg_all_districts_crimes_1996,
  ROUND((AVG(t.crimes_1996) OVER () - o.avg_all)::numeric, 2) AS difference
FROM top3 t
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY t.inhabitants DESC,
         TRANSLATE(LOWER(t.a2), 'áäčďéěëíňóöřšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeeinoorstuuuyz') ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(t.k_symbol) = 'UROK' THEN t.amount WHEN TRIM(t.k_symbol) = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_interest
FROM trans AS t
WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp AS d WHERE d.client_id = 2823)
  AND t.date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date <= DATE '1998-12-31'
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK')

SELECT r.year,
       ROUND(AVG(res.milliseconds)::numeric / 1000.0, 2) AS mean_winner_seconds
FROM public.results res
JOIN public.races r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.position = 1
  AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS driver_count
FROM public.qualifying q
JOIN public.races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND CASE
        WHEN q.q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}$'
        THEN (split_part(q.q2, ':', 1)::int * 60000
              + split_part(q.q2, ':', 2)::numeric * 1000) < 100000
        ELSE FALSE
      END

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorid = q.constructorid
LEFT JOIN results res ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 ~ '^\d+:\d{2}\.\d{3}$'
ORDER BY (split_part(q.q2, ':', 1)::int * 60 + split_part(q.q2, ':', 2)::numeric) ASC,
         CASE WHEN res.grid IS NULL OR res.grid = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         res.grid ASC
OFFSET 1
LIMIT 1

WITH t AS (
  SELECT q.driverid,
         (split_part(q.q3, ':', 1)::int * 60 + split_part(q.q3, ':', 2)::numeric) AS secs
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]+$'
)
SELECT d.nationality
FROM t
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = t.driverid
WHERE t.secs = (SELECT MIN(secs) FROM t)
SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

WITH major_counts AS (
  SELECT mj.major_id, mj.major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS attendee_count
  FROM attendance AS a
  JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
  JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
  JOIN major AS mj ON mj.major_id = m.link_to_major
  WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
  GROUP BY mj.major_id, mj.major_name
)
SELECT major_name, attendee_count
FROM major_counts
WHERE attendee_count = (SELECT MAX(attendee_count) FROM major_counts)
ORDER BY major_name

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member m WHERE m.link_to_major = mj.major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct_majors_without_members
FROM major mj

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    INNER JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
FROM hero_power AS hp
WHERE hp.hero_id IN (
  SELECT hp2.hero_id
  FROM hero_power AS hp2
  INNER JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp2.power_id
  WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm)::numeric, 1) AS avg_height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' LIMIT 1)
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
INNER JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    INNER JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
      AND sp.power_name = 'Flight'
  )

WITH pw AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power AS hp
  INNER JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = hp.hero_id
  WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
),
others AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.weight_kg
  FROM superhero AS s
  INNER JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  WHERE hp.power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM pw)
    AND s.superhero_name <> '3-D Man'
    AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg)::numeric, 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM others

SELECT p.sex,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(lc.cnt, 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_lab_dates
FROM patient AS p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS cnt
  FROM laboratory
  WHERE date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY id
) AS lc ON lc.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM examination e WHERE e.id = p.id)
GROUP BY p.sex
ORDER BY p.sex

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.rf IN ('-', '+-')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM examination e
    WHERE e.id = p.id
      AND (e.kct = '+' OR e.rvvt = '+' OR e.lac = '+')
  )

WITH s AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis, l.dna, CAST(l.dna AS numeric) AS v
  FROM patient AS p
  JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
  WHERE p.diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND l.dna ~ '^\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$'
), best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, diagnosis, dna, v
  FROM s
  ORDER BY id, v DESC, dna
)
SELECT id, diagnosis, dna
FROM best
WHERE v = (SELECT MAX(v) FROM best)
ORDER BY id

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT l.id, l.rnp
  FROM public.laboratory l
  WHERE l.date = (SELECT MAX(l2.date) FROM public.laboratory l2 WHERE l2.id = l.id)
),
pos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id
  FROM latest
  WHERE CASE WHEN TRIM(rnp) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(TRIM(rnp) AS numeric) END >= 32
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'M') AS female_minus_male
FROM pos
JOIN public.patient p ON p.id = pos.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" <= DATE '1998-12-31' AND admission LIKE '+%'

WITH single_mol AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxy AS (
  SELECT sm.molecule_id,
         COUNT(a.atom_id) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'o') AS o_count
  FROM single_mol sm
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = sm.molecule_id
  GROUP BY sm.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(o_count)::numeric, 4) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM oxy

SELECT AVG(cnt)::numeric AS avg_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
) AS t

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND lower(a.element) IN ('na','k','ca','cu','zn','sn','pb','mg','li')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

WITH triple_elements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
    AND a.element IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom a
JOIN triple_elements t ON t.element = a.element
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, a.element ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode)
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.cdscode
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.mailcity)) = 'san francisco'
  AND t.rtype = 'S'
  AND t.avgscrread + t.avgscrmath + t.avgscrwrite >= 1500
  AND f."District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')

SELECT s.school AS school_name, s.county, s.district, s.city,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
       f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS percent_eligible_frpm_k12,
       t.numtsttakr AS sat_test_takers,
       t.avgscrread AS avg_reading_score,
       t.avgscrmath AS avg_math_score,
       t.avgscrwrite AS avg_writing_score,
       t.numge1500 AS test_takers_ge_1500
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
  ON CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(f.cdscode AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT)
   = CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(s.cdscode AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT)
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t
  ON CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(t.cds AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT)
   = CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(s.cdscode AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT)
WHERE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(s.cdscode AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) = 1612590137943

SELECT
  s.school AS school_name,
  s.phone,
  s.website,
  t.avgscrread AS avg_sat_reading,
  t.avgscrmath AS avg_sat_math,
  t.avgscrwrite AS avg_sat_writing,
  (s.charter = 1) AS is_charter,
  f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12_2014_15,
  ROUND(CAST(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS numeric), 2) AS pct_frpm_eligible,
  m.max_math AS highest_avg_sat_math,
  m.max_math - t.avgscrmath AS points_below_highest
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT MAX(t2.avgscrmath) AS max_math
  FROM satscores AS t2
  INNER JOIN schools AS s2 ON s2.cdscode = t2.cds
  WHERE s2.statustype = 'Active' AND t2.numtsttakr >= 10
) AS m
WHERE LTRIM(TRIM(s.cdscode), '0') = '7618040113118'

WITH target AS (
  SELECT county FROM schools WHERE LTRIM(cdscode, '0') = '1100170109835'
  UNION
  SELECT 'Santa Barbara'
)
SELECT t.county AS county, COUNT(s.cdscode) AS exclusive_virtual_schools
FROM target AS t
LEFT JOIN schools AS s ON s.county = t.county AND s.virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY t.county
ORDER BY COUNT(s.cdscode) DESC, t.county ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS release_promo_cards
FROM public.cards
WHERE promotypes ~ '(^|,\s*)release(\s*,|$)'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM public.cards
WHERE bordercolor = 'white'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE WHEN power ~ '^-?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+$' THEN power::numeric < 3 ELSE FALSE END;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN c.frameversion ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN c.frameversion::int END AS fv,
    s.name,
    s.releasedate
  FROM public.cards c
  JOIN public.sets s ON s.code = c.setcode
  WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
),
newest AS (
  SELECT * FROM p
  WHERE fv IS NOT NULL AND fv = (SELECT MAX(fv) FROM p)
)
SELECT DISTINCT name, releasedate
FROM newest
WHERE releasedate = (SELECT MAX(releasedate) FROM newest)

WITH jp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid, fd.name AS japanese_name, c.type AS card_type
  FROM cards c
  JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
    AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
rc AS (
  SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM rulings
  GROUP BY uuid
)
SELECT jp.japanese_name,
       jp.card_type,
       COALESCE(SUM(rc.n), 0)::bigint AS total_rulings
FROM jp
LEFT JOIN rc ON rc.uuid = jp.uuid
GROUP BY jp.japanese_name, jp.card_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
FROM public.cards c
JOIN public.sets s ON s.code = c.setcode
JOIN public.foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND f.text IS NOT NULL
  AND f.text <> ''

SELECT s.id,
       s.name,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.language)
        FROM public.set_translations t
        WHERE t.setcode = s.code) AS language_count
FROM public.sets s
WHERE s.type = 'commander'
  AND s.releasedate >= DATE '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releasedate <= DATE '2020-12-31'
  AND s.totalsetsize = (
    SELECT MAX(s2.totalsetsize)
    FROM public.sets s2
    WHERE s2.type = 'commander'
      AND s2.releasedate >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND s2.releasedate <= DATE '2020-12-31'
  )
ORDER BY s.id ASC

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2010) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
  - 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2011) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_point_difference
FROM public.badges
WHERE name = 'Student'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.score > 50) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM public.posts p
WHERE p.owneruserid = (
  SELECT u.id
  FROM public.users u
  ORDER BY u.reputation DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.reputation)) AS avg_reputation
FROM public.users u
WHERE u.id IN (
  SELECT p.owneruserid
  FROM public.posts p
  WHERE p.tags LIKE '%<r>%'
    AND p.score < 20
    AND p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT SUM(p.score) AS total_score
FROM public.posts p
WHERE p.tags LIKE '%<r>%'
  AND p.id IN (
    SELECT pl.postid
    FROM public.postlinks pl
    JOIN public.posts t ON t.id = pl.relatedpostid
    WHERE t.title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  )

WITH target AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.posts
  WHERE title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT ph.userid,
         COALESCE(u.displayname, ph.userdisplayname) AS displayname,
         COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
  FROM public.posthistory ph
  JOIN target t ON t.id = ph.postid
  LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.id = ph.userid
  WHERE ph.comment IS NOT NULL AND ph.comment <> ''
  GROUP BY ph.userid, COALESCE(u.displayname, ph.userdisplayname)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT userid, displayname, edit_comment_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY edit_comment_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM counts
)
SELECT displayname, edit_comment_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY displayname

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.consumption::numeric END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.consumption::numeric END) AS c2013
  FROM public.yearmonth y
  JOIN public.customers c ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.segment
), pct AS (
  SELECT segment,
         100.0 * (c2013 - c2012) / NULLIF(c2012, 0) AS increase_pct
  FROM seg
  WHERE c2012 IS NOT NULL AND c2013 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE WHEN increase_pct = (SELECT MAX(increase_pct) FROM pct) THEN 'highest' ELSE 'lowest' END AS extreme,
       segment,
       ROUND(increase_pct, 2) AS increase_percentage
FROM pct
WHERE increase_pct = (SELECT MAX(increase_pct) FROM pct)
   OR increase_pct = (SELECT MIN(increase_pct) FROM pct)
ORDER BY increase_pct DESC, segment

SELECT c.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT y.customerid) AS customers_consumed_2013
FROM public.customers c
LEFT JOIN public.yearmonth y
  ON y.customerid = c.customerid
 AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
 AND y.consumption > 0
GROUP BY c.segment

SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumption)::numeric, 2) AS avg_monthly_consumption
FROM public.yearmonth
WHERE customerid = 15621
  AND date LIKE '2013%'
  AND consumption > 0;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM team_attributes ta
JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE LEFT(ta.date, 4) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildupplaypassing > (
    SELECT AVG(buildupplaypassing)
    FROM team_attributes
    WHERE LEFT(date, 4) = '2012'
  )

WITH italy_matches AS (
  SELECT m.*
  FROM match m
  JOIN league l ON l.id = m.league_id
  JOIN country c ON c.id = l.country_id
  WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    AND m.season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
),
appearances AS (
  SELECT season, home_player_1 AS pid FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_2 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_3 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_4 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_5 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_6 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_7 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_8 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_9 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_1 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_2 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_3 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_4 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_5 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_6 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_7 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_8 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_9 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
  UNION SELECT season, away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)
SELECT a.season,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.pid) AS player_count,
       ROUND(AVG(p.height)::numeric, 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM appearances a
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = a.pid
WHERE a.pid IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.season
ORDER BY a.season

WITH mp AS (
  SELECT m.country_id, v.player_id
  FROM match m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (m.home_player_1),(m.home_player_2),(m.home_player_3),(m.home_player_4),(m.home_player_5),(m.home_player_6),
    (m.home_player_7),(m.home_player_8),(m.home_player_9),(m.home_player_10),(m.home_player_11),
    (m.away_player_1),(m.away_player_2),(m.away_player_3),(m.away_player_4),(m.away_player_5),(m.away_player_6),
    (m.away_player_7),(m.away_player_8),(m.away_player_9),(m.away_player_10),(m.away_player_11)
  ) AS v(player_id)
  WHERE v.player_id IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
  SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.player_id) AS cnt
  FROM mp
  JOIN player pl ON pl.player_api_id = mp.player_id
  JOIN country c ON c.id = mp.country_id
  WHERE pl.weight <= 160
  GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT name
FROM counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM counts)

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate
  FROM player_attributes
  ORDER BY player_api_id, date DESC, id DESC
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attacking_work_rate = 'low') / COUNT(*), 1) AS low_attacking_work_rate_pct
FROM latest
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(m.id) AS matches_played
FROM player AS p
LEFT JOIN match AS m
  ON m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND p.player_api_id = ANY (ARRAY[
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6,
    m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6,
    m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  ])
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND p.birthday >= '1991-01-01'
GROUP BY p.id, p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(date)) AS m
  FROM public.account
),
d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT di.district_id, di.a2 AS district_name, CAST(di.a4 AS bigint) AS population
  FROM public.account a
  JOIN public.district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
  CROSS JOIN first_month fm
  WHERE a.date >= fm.m
    AND a.date < fm.m + interval '1 month'
)
SELECT district_name, population
FROM d
WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM d)
